LanguageData.PSC_Set_PermadeathDesc: Default the permadeath option on when starting a captive run. If your captive dies, the run ends.
LanguageData.PSC_Set_AllowSelling: Allow being sold to new owners
LanguageData.PSC_Set_AllowSellingDesc: Captors can hand you off to another faction, which moves you to a new settlement.
LanguageData.PSC_Set_LethalOnEscapeDesc: If you resist or try to flee, captors can escalate to lethal force instead of only subduing you.
LanguageData.PSC_Set_MinigameDesc: When captors seize you, play a struggle minigame to try to break free. If off, seizures resolve automatically as a loss.
LanguageData.PSC_Set_ShowHudDesc: Show the on-screen panel with your defiance, how closely you are watched, and your restraints.
LanguageData.PSC_Set_FeedDesc: Captors keep you fed enough to survive, since they want their property alive and sellable. Turn this off for a brutal run where you must find your own food or starve.
LanguageData.PSC_Set_SellChance: Chance to be sold per check: {0}%
LanguageData.PSC_Set_AllowHarvestDesc: Captors may occasionally cut out a spare organ to sell. It never takes a vital organ, so it will not kill you, but it is grim. Turn this off for a less brutal run.
LanguageData.PSC_Letter_CaptiveBody: {0} is now a captive of {1}, held inside their settlement. You have nothing and almost no freedom. Endure, watch for weakness, and find a way out.
LanguageData.PSC_Msg_Fed: The captors tossed you a ration.
LanguageData.PSC_Msg_Scavenged: You scavenged a few scraps to stay alive.
LanguageData.PSC_Msg_Stole: You wolfed down the stolen {0} before anyone noticed.
LanguageData.PSC_Msg_Disciplined: {0} is being disciplined by the captors.
LanguageData.PSC_Msg_Resisted: You struck a captor. They will make you regret it.
LanguageData.PSC_Letter_SoldBody: {0} has been sold by {1} to {2} and dragged to a new settlement. New owners, new cruelties, and a tighter watch than before.
LanguageData.PSC_Letter_AuctionedBody: {0} was put up on the slave market by {1} and bought by {2}. The auctioneer barely glanced at you. New owners, new cruelties, and a tighter watch than before.
LanguageData.PSC_Struggle_Desc: They have grabbed you and are dragging you {0}. Mash Space or click Struggle to break free before it is too late.
LanguageData.PSC_Msg_BrokeFree: You wrenched free of their grip. The captors will not take that lightly.
LanguageData.PSC_Msg_Subdued: The captors beat you down and drag you back.
LanguageData.PSC_Letter_HarvestBody: {0}'s captors cut out a {1} to sell. To them you are worth more in pieces. It will not be the last thing they take.
LanguageData.PSC_Lock_Desc: Set each pin. Click Set, or press Space, when the slider is over the green mark.
LanguageData.PSC_Lock_DescWatched: A captor is watching. Set the pins fast, before their suspicion boils over.
LanguageData.PSC_Msg_LockCaught: A captor caught you tampering with the lock.
LanguageData.PSC_Restraint_Desc: Twist and pull at the shackles before a guard notices. Mash Space or click Struggle to work them loose.
LanguageData.PSC_Tip_Watched: You are being watched too closely right now.
LanguageData.PSC_Msg_RestraintFail: You could not get them loose this time.
LanguageData.PSC_Msg_CaughtEscaping: You were caught trying to slip away.
LanguageData.PSC_Letter_EscapedBody: {0} slipped out of the settlement and vanished into the wild. You are free. Set up a camp here, then travel or settle as you see fit.
LanguageData.PSC_Letter_FreeBody: {0} is free of the captors at last. The world outside is open and dangerous, but it belongs to no one now.
